annotations.title: Designations and risks at a place

description:
Every planning designation and environmental risk at a place as one flat
    list of {kind, applies, detail, source, as_of, covered}: flood zone, listed
    building, conservation area, Article 4, TPO, Green Belt, AONB, national park,
    SSSI, ancient woodland, brownfield, nutrient catchment, coal. `applies` is
    true, false, or null; null means that layer was not read (covered=false) and
    is NOT the same as "no". Use it to answer "what constraints apply here".

    Flood is Flood Zone 1, 2 or 3 only (Environment Agency). Surface-water,
    river and sea (RoFRS) and defence detail are NOT held, so never describe a
    place as low flood risk from this tool; quote the zone and say surface water
    is not held. Do NOT use it to say a site is buildable, safe or developable.
    Free.
    `include_risk` (uprn places only) also reads the property risk report for
    coal and nutrient catchment; that read costs the /property/risk price and is
    charged only when it returns data. Without it those two items are covered=false.

    `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry}
    (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: at most 40 items (`limit`), one page, cut to 8 KB. A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.
